name: Harness ID
description: Designed to be used with an Anthropic API key only. Rename the harness in the model-facing identity sentence (fork branding) or strip it (privacy). DO NOT combine with cc-bridge (tinkerclaw-tinker-bridge): using the two together may breach the terms of an Anthropic subscription, so this plugin will not start while cc-bridge or an Anthropic OAuth/setup-token login is configured. See README.

mode.description: rename: replace OpenClaw with `name`. strip: drop the harness name entirely.

name.description: Harness name for rename mode. Default: TinkerClaw. Names containing Claude/Anthropic are refused.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: rename = your fork's name; strip = no harness name at all (privacy).

name.label: Harness name
name.help: Shown to the model instead of OpenClaw.
